EmailCVGoogle ScholarLinkedInORCID

Research

  • Scoring spoken English

    Where automated scores of spoken English agree with human raters, where they do not, and what in the recording carries a speaker’s first language.

  • Multilingual learners and policy

    Who can earn the Seal of Biliteracy, and which English learners drop out of public data.

  • Generative AI and academic integrity

    How students and universities judge the use of generative AI.
